title: Other Ways to Say "Okay" in English #shorts
description:
Other ways to say "Okay" in English. Don't say "Okay". Say this instead:
• All right. (everyday)
• Got it. (I understand)
• Works for me. (agreeing to a plan)
• Fine by me. (casual)
• Fair enough. (accepting a point)

Which one will you try today? Write it in the comments.
